mapper.sql:
SELECT EDR.착지업체 AS DLVY_ENTRPS , EDR.출고사업장 AS EDR_DLVY_ENTRPS_NO , (SELECT 사업장명칭 FROM 사업장코드 WHERE 사업장 = EDR.출고사업장) AS EDR_DLVY_ENTRPS_NM , (CASE WHEN CM.배송요일체크 = 'TRUE' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS DLVY_DE_CECK , (CASE WHEN CM.배송월 = 'TRUE' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS DLVY_MON , (CASE WHEN CM.배송화 = 'TRUE' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS DLVY_TUE , (CASE WHEN CM.배송수 = 'TRUE' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS DLVY_WEN , (CASE WHEN CM.배송목 = 'TRUE' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS DLVY_THUR , (CASE WHEN CM.배송금 = 'TRUE' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS DLVY_FRI , RTRIM(CM.상호) AS DLVY_ENTRPS_NM , RTRIM(CM.본_주소) AS DLVY_ENTRPS_ADDRESS
, (CASE WHEN CM.배송요일체크 = 'TRUE' THEN ISNULL(CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM 달력 CLDR WHERE CLDR.사업장 = '20' AND CLDR.일자 = DATE_TAB.DATE_1 AND RTRIM(CLDR.공휴유무) = '') > 0 AND (CASE DATEPART(DW, DATE_TAB.DATE_1) WHEN 1 THEN CM.배송일 WHEN 2 THEN CM.배송월 WHEN 3 THEN CM.배송화 WHEN 4 THEN CM.배송수 WHEN 5 THEN CM.배송목 WHEN 6 THEN CM.배송금 WHEN 7 THEN CM.배송토 END) = 'TRUE' THEN DATE_TAB.DATE_1
WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM 달력 CLDR WHERE CLDR.사업장 = '20' AND CLDR.일자 = DATE_TAB.DATE_2 AND RTRIM(CLDR.공휴유무) = '') > 0 AND (CASE DATEPART(DW, DATE_TAB.DATE_2) WHEN 1 THEN CM.배송일 WHEN 2 THEN CM.배송월 WHEN 3 THEN CM.배송화 WHEN 4 THEN CM.배송수 WHEN 5 THEN CM.배송목 WHEN 6 THEN CM.배송금 WHEN 7 THEN CM.배송토 END) = 'TRUE' THEN DATE_TAB.DATE_2
WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM 달력 CLDR WHERE CLDR.사업장 = '20' AND CLDR.일자 = DATE_TAB.DATE_3 AND RTRIM(CLDR.공휴유무) = '') > 0 AND (CASE DATEPART(DW, DATE_TAB.DATE_3) WHEN 1 THEN CM.배송일 WHEN 2 THEN CM.배송월 WHEN 3 THEN CM.배송화 WHEN 4 THEN CM.배송수 WHEN 5 THEN CM.배송목 WHEN 6 THEN CM.배송금 WHEN 7 THEN CM.배송토 END) = 'TRUE' THEN DATE_TAB.DATE_3
WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM 달력 CLDR WHERE CLDR.사업장 = '20' AND CLDR.일자 = DATE_TAB.DATE_4 AND RTRIM(CLDR.공휴유무) = '') > 0 AND (CASE DATEPART(DW, DATE_TAB.DATE_4) WHEN 1 THEN CM.배송일 WHEN 2 THEN CM.배송월 WHEN 3 THEN CM.배송화 WHEN 4 THEN CM.배송수 WHEN 5 THEN CM.배송목 WHEN 6 THEN CM.배송금 WHEN 7 THEN CM.배송토 END) = 'TRUE' THEN DATE_TAB.DATE_4
WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM 달력 CLDR WHERE CLDR.사업장 = '20' AND CLDR.일자 = DATE_TAB.DATE_5 AND RTRIM(CLDR.공휴유무) = '') > 0 AND (CASE DATEPART(DW, DATE_TAB.DATE_5) WHEN 1 THEN CM.배송일 WHEN 2 THEN CM.배송월 WHEN 3 THEN CM.배송화 WHEN 4 THEN CM.배송수 WHEN 5 THEN CM.배송목 WHEN 6 THEN CM.배송금 WHEN 7 THEN CM.배송토 END) = 'TRUE' THEN DATE_TAB.DATE_5
WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM 달력 CLDR WHERE CLDR.사업장 = '20' AND CLDR.일자 = DATE_TAB.DATE_6 AND RTRIM(CLDR.공휴유무) = '') > 0 AND (CASE DATEPART(DW, DATE_TAB.DATE_6) WHEN 1 THEN CM.배송일 WHEN 2 THEN CM.배송월 WHEN 3 THEN CM.배송화 WHEN 4 THEN CM.배송수 WHEN 5 THEN CM.배송목 WHEN 6 THEN CM.배송금 WHEN 7 THEN CM.배송토 END) = 'TRUE' THEN DATE_TAB.DATE_6
WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM 달력 CLDR WHERE CLDR.사업장 = '20' AND CLDR.일자 = DATE_TAB.DATE_7 AND RTRIM(CLDR.공휴유무) = '') > 0 AND (CASE DATEPART(DW, DATE_TAB.DATE_7) WHEN 1 THEN CM.배송일 WHEN 2 THEN CM.배송월 WHEN 3 THEN CM.배송화 WHEN 4 THEN CM.배송수 WHEN 5 THEN CM.배송목 WHEN 6 THEN CM.배송금 WHEN 7 THEN CM.배송토 END) = 'TRUE' THEN DATE_TAB.DATE_7 END, DBO.웹_납기일자_함수(EDR.착지업체, GETDATE()))
ELSE DBO.웹_납기일자_함수(EDR.착지업체, GETDATE()) END) AS DEADLINE

FROM 거래처MASTER CM JOIN 업체배송지등록 EDR WITH(NOLOCK) ON (CM.등록사업장 = EDR.출고사업장 AND CM.거래처코드 = EDR.착지업체)
, (SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR , DATEADD(DAY, 1, GETDATE()) ,112) AS DATE_1 , CONVERT(VARCHAR , DATEADD(DAY, 2, GETDATE()) ,112) AS DATE_2 , CONVERT(VARCHAR , DATEADD(DAY, 3, GETDATE()) ,112) AS DATE_3 , CONVERT(VARCHAR , DATEADD(DAY, 4, GETDATE()) ,112) AS DATE_4 , CONVERT(VARCHAR , DATEADD(DAY, 5, GETDATE()) ,112) AS DATE_5 , CONVERT(VARCHAR , DATEADD(DAY, 6, GETDATE()) ,112) AS DATE_6 , CONVERT(VARCHAR , DATEADD(DAY, 7, GETDATE()) ,112) AS DATE_7 ) AS DATE_TAB

SELECT TOP (#{pg} * #{pgCnt}) BPLC.사업장 AS BPLC_CODE , BPLC.사업장명칭 AS BPLC_NM , BPLC.사업장약칭 AS BPLC_ABRV , BPLC.세무서코드 AS BPLC_TAXOFCCODE , BPLC.관할세무서 AS BPLC_CMPTNCTAXOFC , BPLC.사업장주소 AS BPLC_ADDRES , BPLC.업태 AS BPLC_BIZCND , BPLC.종목 AS BPLC_ITEM

WHERE 1=1
AND ( UPPER(RTRIM(BPLC.사업장명칭)) LIKE UPPER('%'+RTRIM(#{searchData1})+'%') OR UPPER(RTRIM(BPLC.사업장)) LIKE UPPER('%'+RTRIM(#{searchData1})+'%') )
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
AND ( UPPER(RTRIM(CM.거래처코드)) LIKE UPPER('%'+#{searchData1}+'%') OR UPPER(RTRIM(CM.상호)) LIKE UPPER('%'+#{searchData1}+'%') OR UPPER(RTRIM(CM.사업자번호)) LIKE UPPER('%'+#{searchData1}+'%') )

SELECT TOP (#{pg} * #{pgCnt}) RTRIM(CM.거래처코드) AS WC_BCNC_CODE , RTRIM(CM.상호) AS CM_ENTRPS_NM , RTRIM(CM.사업자번호) AS CM_BIZR_NO , RTRIM(CM.대표자성명) AS CM_CEO_NM , CM.최소주문량 AS CM_MUMM_ORR_QY , CONVERT(numeric, CM.출고정지) AS CM_DLIVY_STOP , CM.등록사업장 AS CM_REG_BPLC , CONVERT(numeric, CM.어음한도) AS CM_BIL_LMT , CONVERT(numeric, CM.외상한도) AS CM_CRDT_LMT
AND ( UPPER(RTRIM(CM.거래처코드)) LIKE UPPER('%'+#{searchData1}+'%') OR UPPER(RTRIM(CM.상호)) LIKE UPPER('%'+#{searchData1}+'%') OR UPPER(RTRIM(CM.사업자번호)) LIKE UPPER('%'+#{searchData1}+'%') )
ORDER BY RTRIM(CM.상호)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM ( SELECT RTRIM(CM.거래처코드) AS WC_BCNC_CODE , RTRIM(CM.상호) AS CM_ENTRPS_NM , RTRIM(CM.사업자번호) AS CM_BIZR_NO , RTRIM(CM.대표자성명) AS CM_CEO_NM , CM.최소주문량 AS CM_MUMM_ORR_QY , CONVERT(numeric, CM.출고정지) AS CM_DLIVY_STOP , CM.등록사업장 AS CM_REG_BPLC , CONVERT(numeric, CM.어음한도) AS CM_BIL_LMT , CONVERT(numeric, CM.외상한도) AS CM_CRDT_LMT
, (CASE WHEN CONVERT(numeric, CM.어음한도) IN (1,2) THEN DBO.미수계산_함수(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), getdate(),112), RTRIM(CM.거래처코드)) ELSE 0 END) AS FN_UNCLAMT_CAL
, (CASE WHEN CONVERT(numeric, CM.어음한도) = 2 THEN ISNULL(DBO.미수계산_기간(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),getdate(),112), CONVERT(numeric, CM.외상한도), RTRIM(CM.거래처코드)), 0) ELSE 0 END) AS FN_UNCLAMT_PD
) TAB
WHERE 1=1

SELECT TOP (#{pg} * #{pgCnt}) TAB.* , (CASE WHEN ( CASE WHEN TAB.CM_REG_BPLC = '60' THEN (CASE WHEN TAB.CM_DLIVY_STOP = 1 THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END) ELSE (CASE WHEN TAB.CM_BIL_LMT = 1 THEN (CASE WHEN (TAB.CM_CRDT_LMT - TAB.FN_UNCLAMT_CAL) > 0 THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END) WHEN TAB.CM_BIL_LMT = 2 THEN (CASE WHEN TAB.FN_UNCLAMT_CAL > 0 THEN (CASE WHEN ISNULL(TAB.FN_UNCLAMT_PD, 0) > 0 THEN 'FALSE' ELSE 'TRUE' END) ELSE 'FALSE' END) ELSE 'FALSE' END) END ) = 'FALSE' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END) AS UNCLAMT_EXST_AT -- false 가능, true 불가 FROM( SELECT RTRIM(CM.거래처코드) AS WC_BCNC_CODE , RTRIM(CM.상호) AS CM_ENTRPS_NM , RTRIM(CM.사업자번호) AS CM_BIZR_NO , RTRIM(CM.대표자성명) AS CM_CEO_NM , CM.최소주문량 AS CM_MUMM_ORR_QY , CONVERT(numeric, CM.출고정지) AS CM_DLIVY_STOP , CM.등록사업장 AS CM_REG_BPLC , CONVERT(numeric, CM.어음한도) AS CM_BIL_LMT , CONVERT(numeric, CM.외상한도) AS CM_CRDT_LMT
, (CASE WHEN CONVERT(numeric, CM.어음한도) IN (1,2) THEN DBO.미수계산_함수(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), getdate(),112), RTRIM(CM.거래처코드)) ELSE 0 END) AS FN_UNCLAMT_CAL
, (CASE WHEN CONVERT(numeric, CM.어음한도) = 2 THEN ISNULL(DBO.미수계산_기간(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),getdate(),112), CONVERT(numeric, CM.외상한도), RTRIM(CM.거래처코드)), 0) ELSE 0 END) AS FN_UNCLAMT_PD
) TAB
WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY RTRIM(TAB.CM_ENTRPS_NM)
